Guidance & outlook: I am confident that with the strength of our long experience and equipment, we will definitely succeed in fulfilling our objectives.
Our order book stands at over Rs 5,001 crores, providing clear visibility for the next two to three years.
After that, in the next year, there will be an execution of approximately 50% combining both the years.
Growth & demand: In the past three years, the Railways had about 15% to 17% contribution to the company's order book.
On the business development side, our bidding pipeline remains healthy at over Rs 3,000 crores with tenders submitted in roads, bridges, urban infrastructure and renewable link construction.
Sir, in the next six months plus FY'27, overall 50% of the order book will be executed.
Margins & costs: 24 crores, declining by around 50% year-on-year basis, with EBITDA margin at 8.25%.
56 crores, down 32% year -on-year basis, with EBITDA margin of 9.84%.

The moderation in EBITDA and PA T margin was largely due to higher working capital utilization during the early part of the quarter, slo wer repayment releases from free water supply projects, and initial mobilization expenses on newly commenced projects.
Capex & expansion: In Jaipur, along with 30 MLD sewerage treatment plants, our elevation works of academic blocks of Fintech Digital Institute is also included.
In this financial year 2.52 lakh crores capital is allocated by the government focusing on schemes such as expansion of the railway, redevelopment of the railway station, and security support.
In the same way, our steel structure and girder plants are working on their full capacity.
Balance sheet & cash: 8.5 crores, based purely on the aging of receivables.

With receivable inflows improving significantly from Oc tober, and with external borrowing reducing due to increased promoter support, we expect interest costs to be declined and margins to gradually improve as execution picks up in the second half of the year.

60 crores we have done debt payment and rest we have infused in working capital and your second question is that our debtors level has increased, if you will see that our traction in work- in-progress is around Rs.
Risks & challenges: As you all are aware since the last 21-22 months, the infrastructure sector has been under a lot of pressure.
Despite these challenges, our basic principles have been strengthened.
However, during the year, the increase in receiptshas also been a challenge.
